name: knowledge-dungeon
description: Knowledge Dungeon - a local-first, mindmap-driven dungeon crawler for studying. Built on the Repo Dungeon engine.
author: McFuzzySquirrel

scripts.build:web:pixi-village: VITE_WORLD_RENDERER=phaser VITE_PIXI_VILLAGE=true VITE_PIXI_DUNGEON=false VITE_PIXI_FISHING=false npm run build:web
scripts.build:web:pixi-dungeon: VITE_WORLD_RENDERER=phaser VITE_PIXI_DUNGEON=true VITE_PIXI_VILLAGE=false VITE_PIXI_FISHING=false npm run build:web
scripts.build:web:pixi-fishing: VITE_WORLD_RENDERER=phaser VITE_PIXI_FISHING=true VITE_PIXI_VILLAGE=false VITE_PIXI_DUNGEON=false npm run build:web
scripts.build:web:pixi-route: VITE_WORLD_RENDERER=phaser VITE_PIXI_DUNGEON=true VITE_PIXI_FISHING=true VITE_PIXI_VILLAGE=false npm run build:web
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:electron:web && npm run build:electron:main
scripts.package:electron:win:zip: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win zip
scripts.package:electron:linux: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --linux deb
scripts.package:electron:linux:appimage: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --linux AppImage
scripts.build:storage-v2-flagged: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode storage-v2
scripts.release:verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build:web && npm run check:bundle-size && npm run check:budget:welcome && npm run check:memory && npm run check:perf && npm run record:build-metadata
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:web && playwright test tests/e2e/currentBuild.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:compat: npm run build:web && npm run record:web-artifact && playwright test tests/e2e/compatibility.spec.ts --project=compat-chromium --project=compat-firefox --project=compat-webkit --project=compat-edge
scripts.test:e2e:storage: npm run build:storage-v2-flagged && npm run record:web-artifact:storage-v2 && playwright test --config=playwright.storage-v2.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:data-products:full: npm run build:storage-v2-data-products && npm run record:web-artifact:storage-v2 && playwright test --config=playwright.data-products.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:subject-product:full: npm run build:storage-v2-data-products && npm run record:web-artifact:storage-v2 && playwright test --config=playwright.subject-product.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:reload-persistence:full: npm run build:storage-v2-data-products && npm run record:web-artifact:storage-v2 && playwright test --config=playwright.reload-persistence.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:pixi-memory:full: npm run build:web:pixi && npm run record:web-artifact:pixi && node scripts/require-pixi-lane-artifact.mjs && playwright test --config=tests/e2e/playwright.pixi-memory.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:pixi-pointer:full: npm run build:web:pixi && npm run record:web-artifact:pixi && node scripts/require-pixi-lane-artifact.mjs && playwright test --config=tests/e2e/playwright.pixi-pointer.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:pixi-perf:full: npm run build:web:pixi-dungeon && npm run record:web-artifact:pixi-dungeon && node scripts/require-pixi-perf-lane-artifact.mjs && playwright test --config=tests/e2e/playwright.pixi-perf.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:pixi-route:full: npm run build:web:pixi-route && npm run record:web-artifact:pixi-route && npm run verify:web-artifact:pixi-route && playwright test --config=tests/e2e/playwright.pixi-route.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:fishing:full: npm run build:web:pixi-fishing && npm run record:web-artifact:pixi-fishing && npm run verify:web-artifact:pixi-fishing && node scripts/require-fishing-lane-artifact.mjs && playwright test --config=tests/e2e/playwright.fishing.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:fishing:rollback:full: npm run build:web:rollback && npm run record:web-artifact:rollback && npm run verify:web-artifact:rollback && node scripts/require-fishing-lane-artifact.mjs --rollback && playwright test --config=tests/e2e/playwright.fishing-rollback.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:assistance:full: npm run build:web:assistance && npm run record:web-artifact:assistance && npm run verify:web-artifact:assistance && node scripts/require-assistance-lane-artifact.mjs && playwright test --config=tests/e2e/playwright.assistance.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:assistance:default:full: npm run build:web:rollback && npm run record:web-artifact:rollback && npm run verify:web-artifact:rollback && node scripts/require-assistance-lane-artifact.mjs --default && playwright test --config=tests/e2e/playwright.assistance-default.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:phase10-media:full: npm run build:web && npm run record:web-artifact && npm run verify:web-artifact && node scripts/require-phase10-lane-artifact.mjs && playwright test --config=tests/e2e/playwright.phase10-media.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:offline:full: npm run build:web:offline && npm run record:web-artifact:offline && node scripts/require-offline-lane-artifact.mjs && playwright test --config=tests/e2e/playwright.offline.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:sw-shell:full: npm run build:web:offline && npm run record:web-artifact:offline && node scripts/require-offline-lane-artifact.mjs && playwright test --config=tests/e2e/playwright.sw-shell.config.ts
